title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best Auckland gyms by suburb with prices from $15/week. Compare gym memberships
intro: Aucklanders have plenty of gym options to choose from, with prices ranging from $15 to over $50 per week. With so many choices, it can be hard to decide which one is best for you. This guide will help you navigate the best gyms in Auckland by suburb, including commuter gyms and CBD options.

sections.heading: Gym Options by Suburb
sections.body: Auckland has a wide range of gyms across different suburbs. Some popular options include Snap Fitness in the CBD, Anytime Fitness in Newmarket, and Jetts in Takapuna. These gyms offer a range of equipment and classes, with prices varying depending on the location and membership type.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: For those who commute to work, a gym near a major transport hub can be a great option. The Auckland CBD has several gyms to choose from, including Snap Fitness and Les Mills. These gyms offer a range of equipment and classes, and are open early and late to accommodate busy schedules.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: For those who drive to the gym, parking can be a major consideration. Some gyms, such as Jetts in Takapuna, offer free parking for members. Others, such as Snap Fitness in the CBD, are located near public transport hubs and do not offer parking. It's worth considering the parking options when choosing a gym.
